svg.title: Prepare, test, and share the archive
svg.desc: An archive folder contains inputs or access instructions, code, README and SPECIFICATION files, software versions, and results. The agent restores a separate software environment, runs saved commands, and compares results. A report distinguishes passed, failed, and untested checks; failures return to the archive for repair and another test. The tested version can be sent as a zipped copy to a collaborator or deposited in Dataverse, Zenodo, or Dryad.
svg.text: Link the shared files to the manuscript version
